Modifier-first order entry

Offline-first. Always.

When the Spectrum line goes down at 7:14am, Counter keeps ringing, queues 72 hours of charges, and reconciles cleanly the moment wifi returns.

  • Auto-export to Gusto, ADP, Justworks
  • Staff sees their split in the team app

FREQUENTLY ASKED

Questions our shop owners ask before signing.

Does it work offline if my wifi drops mid-rush? +

Yes — Counter is offline-first by design. Every charge writes to a local encrypted SQLite ledger on the tablet first, then syncs to our backend. We've measured 72 hours of full operation off-grid in a Brooklyn power test (Aug 2025). Tap-to-pay continues working via cached EMV scripts; we settle automatically once you're back online, with idempotency keys preventing double-charges.

How do tips and tip-out splits work between bar, kitchen, and counter? +

You set weights per role (e.g. counter 1.0, bar 0.8, kitchen 0.4) and split policy per shop. At close, Counter calculates each person's share by hours worked × role weight, shows the math line-by-line, and pushes a payroll file to Gusto/ADP/Justworks on Sunday. Staff sees their own line in the Counter Team app, signed off by managers.

Can I integrate Square Online or Toast Online for delivery? +

Yes, both — plus ChowNow, DoorDash Drive, and Uber Eats. Orders route straight to KDS with the right channel tag (we mark Toast Online tickets in orange so your bar knows what's a pickup). Menu sync is bi-directional: edit in Counter, see it on Square Online within 12 seconds.

What's the cost of the card reader — is it included? +

The CR-1 reader is $89 outright, or included in the kit lease ($39/mo, yours after 12 months). Tap, chip, and swipe all included; no per-tap surcharge. Solo plan gets one, Multi includes one per location with extras at $79.

Do I have to buy proprietary hardware to run Counter? +

No. Counter runs on any iPad (10th gen+) or Android tablet (Android 12+). We support Star TSP143/mC-Print3, Epson TM-m30, and any EMV reader on Stripe Terminal — BBPOS WisePOS E, M2, S700. Bring-your-own-hardware saves you $20/mo.
